proposed_difference: Live Settings lists extra rows (profile and licences, verification, documents, continuity plan, all notifications, physician referrals when waiting, privacy and account, demos and sandbox, admin console for admins) and a Sign out row, after the approved rows.
reason_and_constraint: The approved Settings offers only Availability, Notification preferences and Preview controls. A real signed-in member also needs the account pages the mock-up leaves to the host product, and a way to sign out (concern C-01). The approved rows, order and copy are unchanged and Preview controls are hidden on live accounts.

proposed_difference: Live toasts drop the clause 'Delivery is simulated locally' and state what really happened (for example 'Cover requests sent', 'N colleagues were not asked').
reason_and_constraint: A live request really is sent. Saying it is simulated would be false (C-12). Fixture and sandbox preview keep the approved wording.

proposed_difference: In-person eligibility uses the colleague's licence city for that state, not only their primary practice city.
reason_and_constraint: The product stores a city per licence; the mock-up has one city per clinician (C-11). The approved rule (same state, in-person needs a matching city) is unchanged.
target_evidence: v13 backend tests for cover_exclusions / referral_exclusions

proposed_difference: A colleague sees only their own request and its status, not who else was asked or who else replied. A referral owner sees all replies.
reason_and_constraint: Privacy: the mock-up shows every colleague everything because there is one viewer (C-13).

proposed_difference: Messages can be edited for 15 minutes; removing is always allowed. Long conversations load the latest 200 with a text 'Show earlier messages' button. The date line shows the real day.
reason_and_constraint: Existing product rule (C-18); real conversations are long (C-19); the mock-up's 'Today' would be wrong on real data (C-23).

proposed_difference: The Edit/Remove menu on the first message of a conversation opens above the header strip instead of beneath it.
reason_and_constraint: In the approved design that menu opens underneath the header strip and cannot be clicked (C-17).

proposed_difference: Ask a question requires the 'no details that identify a client' box to be ticked; up to 10 tags; the server refuses otherwise.
reason_and_constraint: Product safety rule that already exists (C-31).

proposed_difference: The design has no Report, Block, supervision or resolve-question control. Live adds none; reporting and supervision stay on their existing pages (concerns C-25, C-27, C-28).
reason_and_constraint: The approved design removes controls the product has. They are kept reachable rather than deleted; Nick to decide whether to add them to the design.

proposed_difference: Provisional templates (PA-xx not yet professionally reviewed) are listed as 'Coming soon' on the live site with no file; the supplied-draft label and files appear only on preview builds.
reason_and_constraint: The database refuses publishing without reviewer roles and live must not offer unreviewed legal templates as finished (C-32). The approved card, labels and detail layout are unchanged.

proposed_difference: Invitation is copy-only (nothing is sent); a colleague who joins from your link is not automatically trusted.
reason_and_constraint: SPEC says the colleague and you 'choose separately' whether to trust each other; the old behaviour added them to the trusted list automatically (C-26).

proposed_difference: First click on a directory result is no longer lost when the field loses focus.
reason_and_constraint: Defect in the reference engine (C-34); fix is a guard on re-render when filters did not change.

proposed_difference: Null guards and in-flight flags added around posting and reply (double click, offline retry); reply text preserved across re-render while a discussion loads.
reason_and_constraint: Duplicate-safe retries are a requirement; the reference engine posts twice or throws on a double click.

proposed_difference: Open Messages asks for changes every 15 s (30 s elsewhere) and when the tab becomes visible, instead of push.
reason_and_constraint: No realtime service in the stack (C-09).

proposed_difference: Directory and library lists load whole in the browser; Consult list holds the latest 200 discussions.
reason_and_constraint: Fine for founding-cohort numbers; paging noted for later (C-07, C-30, C-35).
